# repo-uses-apm

Relayed from: operator, 2026-10-15: "Instead of aim, this repository should use APM".

## Intent

aim manages, from `aim.toml` and `aim.lock.toml`: 13 rules from `https://github.com/jasperhg90/skills` (`rules/*.md`, written to `.claude/rules/`), 3 skills from the same repository (agent-creator, rule-creator, generate-art, written to `.claude/skills/`), and two marker regions in `AGENTS.md` (the `aim:` header and the guidelines block; `CLAUDE.md` is a link to `AGENTS.md`). APM (Microsoft's Agent Package Manager, https://microsoft.github.io/apm) replaces it:

- An `new:apm.yml` declares the repository as an APM project and lists the same rules and skills as `dependencies.apm` entries pointing at their paths in `jasperhg90/skills`, pinned to a ref; `apm install` writes them, and its lock file (`new:apm.lock.yaml`, or the name APM uses) pins their content.
- The rules land in `.claude/rules/` with their `paths:` front matter intact, so Claude Code loads them by path as today; the skills land in `.claude/skills/`. Files that are not from aim (this repository's own rules, such as `okf-bundle.md`, `diagrams-stay-current.md`, `manifesto-invariants.md`, `docs-layout.md`, `measure-before-ticketing.md`, `adversarial-reviews.md`, `cli-interface.md`, `cli-version-floor.md`, `skills-are-thin.md`, `skills-via-skill-creator.md`, `python-*` ones not in the list) are left as they are.
- The `AGENTS.md` guidelines block is either produced by APM (its instructions compiled into `AGENTS.md`) or kept as plain text owned by this repository; the `aim:` markers and the header line naming aim go either way.
- `aim.toml` and `aim.lock.toml` are removed, and `CLAUDE.md`'s routing text no longer says rules come from aim; `.loop/config.toml` gates and the loop's own plugin are untouched.

Measured: aim manages 16 items here (13 rules, 3 skills) and 2 marker regions; 0 are managed by APM.

Done when `apm install` in a clean clone writes the same 13 rule files and 3 skills, byte for byte or with only APM's own header lines added, to the same paths; `aim.toml` and `aim.lock.toml` are gone; no file names aim; the `AGENTS.md` guidelines text is unchanged in meaning; and the gates pass.

## Could invalidate this plan

- APM may not install a plain `rules/*.md` file to `.claude/rules/` with its `paths:` front matter, since its own instruction format is `*.instructions.md` with `applyTo`, and `jasperhg90/skills` may not be an APM package at all. Spike it: install the APM CLI in a scratch folder and try one rule and one skill from that repository into a scratch clone.
